source: Parliament vote results, part descriptions of amendment 4, A-10-2026-0257
wordingEn: (3)	The Union needs to support and prepare its people, starting from an early age, with the knowledge, skills and competences needed for success in learning, work, and life. To enable this, the Union needs high-quality, performing, agile, innovative and inclusive education and training systems, able to nurture, attract and retain talent across the Union. The Union should also support learners’ personal and professional growth, active citizenship and lifelong learning, to keep up with the pace and scope of the ongoing societal, digital, environmental and economic transformations, respond to the demographic challenges and the society’s and economy’s skills needs, bridge skills gaps, including in critical sectors.

За да стане възможно това, Съюзът се нуждае от висококачествени, ефективни, лесно приспособими, иновативни и приобщаващи системи за образование и обучение, които да могат да възпитават, привличат и задържат таланти в рамките на Съюза.
